name: funwind
description: FunWind · 青翼字幕组（QYSUB）新论坛

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @funwind/db build && pnpm --filter @funwind/content build && pnpm --filter @funwind/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @funwind/db build && pnpm --filter @funwind/content build && pnpm --filter @funwind/web dev
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f docker/dev/compose.yaml up -d mailpit && pnpm test:e2e:run
scripts.test:e2e:run: export STORAGE_DIR="$PWD/storage-e2e" SMTP_URL="smtp://127.0.0.1:1025" MAIL_FROM="青翼字幕组 <noreply@qingyisub.top>" && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync(process.env.STORAGE_DIR,{recursive:true,force:true})" && pnpm db:build && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm --filter @funwind/db exec tsx scripts/e2e-reset.ts && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm db:bootstrap && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm db:seed && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm db:e2e-fixtures && APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3201 NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm --filter @funwind/web test:e2e:prod && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm --filter @funwind/db exec tsx scripts/e2e-reset.ts && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm db:bootstrap && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm db:seed && NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm db:e2e-fixtures && APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3200 NEW_DB_NAME=qysub_next_e2e pnpm --filter @funwind/web test:e2e
scripts.migrate: pnpm --filter @funwind/db build && pnpm --filter @funwind/content build && pnpm --filter @funwind/migration migrate
scripts.verify:migration: pnpm --filter @funwind/db build && pnpm --filter @funwind/content build && pnpm --filter @funwind/migration verify && pnpm --filter @funwind/web verify:render && pnpm --filter @funwind/web verify:fidelity
scripts.verify:all: pnpm check:secrets && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
